title: [Foundation] Enable main branch protection and required checks
body:
## Goal
Protect `main` from accidental direct/unchecked changes.

## Required settings
- require pull request before merge
- require the `rocksoul-gate` status checks
- block force pushes and branch deletion
- keep squash merge as the preferred history style

## Note
This is an admin setting and is intentionally not claimed as automated until GitHub reports the branch/ruleset protected.

## Acceptance
- `main` reports protection/ruleset enabled
- a PR cannot merge while required `rocksoul-gate` checks are failing

title: [Foundation] Choose and add an explicit repository license
body:
## Goal
Choose the intended RockSoul source license explicitly rather than implicitly publishing with no license.

## Acceptance
- license decision is documented
- root license file exists
- README reflects the chosen license
- dependency/license compatibility is reviewed

title: [Foundation] Activate public Project, Wiki and repository sync
body:
## Goal
Activate the privileged synchronization surfaces that cannot be managed by the default Actions token alone.

## Target
- user-owned public GitHub Project named `rocksoul`
- Kanban, Roadmap and Backlog views
- Priority and Phase fields synchronized from labels
- repository linked to the Project
- Wiki synchronized from `/docs`
- repository description/topics/template/discussions/merge settings synchronized

## Blocker
Add one Actions secret named `ROCKSOUL_GITHUB_TOKEN`. The token must have GitHub Projects `project` scope plus sufficient public-repository administration and Wiki access.

`rocksoul-sync` intentionally skips this privileged job with a notice when the secret is absent; labels, milestones and canonical Issues continue to synchronize with `GITHUB_TOKEN`.

## Acceptance
- Project `rocksoul` exists and is PUBLIC
- Kanban/Roadmap/Backlog views exist
- open canonical issues are present
- Wiki pages mirror `/docs`
- repository metadata/template/discussion/merge settings match governance
- Issues + milestones + labels remain canonical sources of truth

title: [Foundation] Commit Cargo.lock for reproducible application builds
body:
## Goal
Treat RockSoul as an application workspace and make dependency resolution reproducible across CI, development, audit, and release builds.

## Scope
- generate and commit the workspace `Cargo.lock`
- keep it updated through Dependabot/Cargo changes
- ensure security audit uses the committed lockfile rather than relying on fresh unconstrained resolution

## Acceptance
- root `Cargo.lock` is tracked
- CI and RustSec operate against the committed resolution
- dependency updates modify the lockfile intentionally

title: [Foundation] Configure GitHub repository metadata and topics
body:
## Goal
Make the GitHub repository landing metadata consistent with the README and architecture.

## Scope
- concise repository description
- focused discovery topics
- template/discussions/wiki/project settings
- merge strategy and automatic merged-branch deletion

## Acceptance
- repository About metadata matches current positioning
- topics do not overclaim AGI/ASI
- optional GitHub features have deliberate roles
- README and repository metadata do not contradict each other

title: [Foundation] Connect canonical Web mirror to Vercel
body:
## Goal
Deploy the zero-build `public/` interface from this canonical repository to Vercel without creating a second frontend source.

## Scope
- import `bjo163/rocksoul` as its own Vercel project
- project root is repository root
- framework preset Other / static output from `public/`
- production follows `main`
- feature branches receive preview deployments
- verify TUI/Web display parity from `public/brand.env`

## Non-goal
Do not repurpose the existing unrelated `rocksoul-web` Vercel project unless it is explicitly migrated later.

## Acceptance
- canonical RockSoul Vercel deployment exists
- production deployment comes from `main`
- Web surface renders the same identity/state labels as the TUI
- deployment URL is added to repository homepage metadata

title: [Phase A] Persist birth identity and append-only lifecycle journal
body:
## Goal
Make RockSoul's birth and lifecycle restart-safe.

## Scope
- persist identity and birth event
- append-only lifecycle/event journal
- derive chronological age from persisted birth
- recovery/restart tests

## Non-goals
- PostgreSQL memory system
- World graph
- model inference

## Acceptance
- restart does not create a new identity/birth
- journal preserves lifecycle events
- corrupted/missing state fails explicitly
- CI remains green

title: [Phase B] Implement World Graph, discovery state and Ratatui map
body:
## Goal
Represent the Internet and authorized digital environment as an explicit navigable world.

## Scope
World/place/entity primitives, relations, discovery/fog-of-war, current location/activity, provenance/trust metadata, finite exploration budgets, Ratatui WORLD view.

## Non-goal
No 3D/metaverse renderer in this phase.

## Acceptance
The same world state can be serialized, tested, and rendered without coupling cognition to Ratatui.

title: [Phase C] Implement persistent four-part memory system
body:
## Goal
Implement working, episodic, semantic and procedural memory with persistence.

## Scope
PostgreSQL, provenance, freshness, supersession, deterministic retrieval contracts. Add pgvector only when semantic retrieval evidence warrants it.

## Acceptance
Memory types remain distinguishable, provenance survives persistence, stale/superseded knowledge is representable, and retrieval is testable.

title: [Phase D] Integrate RockSoul Nano behind a stable Rust Brain interface
body:
## Goal
Consume a versioned RockSoul Nano artifact from `rocksoul-mind` without depending on its Python internals.

## Scope
Stable Brain trait/interface, artifact metadata/versioning, Rust-native inference path, intent/routing/extraction/structured output evaluation.

## Acceptance
Production inference runs without a Python service and model swaps do not change higher-level cognition contracts.

title: [Phase E] Build deterministic Skills / Yad executor
body:
## Goal
Give RockSoul controlled action capability through deterministic tools.

## Initial scope
Web/search abstraction, files, GitHub, HTTP/API and PostgreSQL read.

## Acceptance
Every skill has typed/validated input, bounded execution, explicit result/error output, audit metadata and no hidden authority escalation.

title: [Phase F] Implement the Global Cognitive Workspace and finite executive loop
body:
## Goal
Replace transcript-only state with explicit structured cognition.

## State
Goals, constraints, facts, beliefs, unknowns, hypotheses, evidence, plans, actions, observations, confidence and budgets.

## Acceptance
Facts/beliefs/hypotheses remain distinct and every executive loop has finite step/tool/replan/time/cost/risk budgets.

title: [Phase G] Implement Tabayyun / Guardian verification and authority gates
body:
## Goal
Make verification, provenance and authorization first-class runtime gates.

## Scope
Schema validation, source provenance, freshness, contradiction detection, confidence, permission policy, action risk classes and audit trail.

## Invariant
Intelligence never implies authority.

## Acceptance
Consequential actions cannot bypass policy even if suggested by the model.

title: [Phase H] Implement missions, validated XP, level, cognitive age and trust progression
body:
## Goal
Turn life progression into measurable observability/evaluation rather than decorative game numbers.

## Scope
Missions, domain XP, level curve, achievements, cognitive-age benchmark gates, trust/delegation metrics.

## Acceptance
Unvalidated activity earns no success XP; cognitive age can regress/reject candidates; trust never bypasses policy.

title: [Phase I] Integrate evidence-selected RockSoul Cortex
body:
## Goal
Integrate the reasoning/planning Cortex selected by evidence from `rocksoul-mind` (research target roughly 300–600M, not a fixed promise).

## Acceptance
Measured gains in reasoning/planning justify runtime cost; Cortex uses the same world/memory/evidence contracts rather than becoming a parallel system.

title: [Phase J] Add on-demand Shura multi-perspective reasoning
body:
## Goal
Use multiple perspectives only when complexity warrants it.

## Non-goal
No permanent agent swarm.

## Acceptance
Routing has an explicit complexity trigger, bounded cost, shared workspace/evidence, and evaluation showing benefit over single-Cortex reasoning.

title: [Phase K] Build policy-gated autonomous research loops
body:
## Goal
Support finite goal → research → hypothesis → experiment/code → observe → verify → report loops.

## Acceptance
Loops are budgeted, interruptible, auditable, evidence-grounded and permission-gated. Failures terminate explicitly rather than wandering indefinitely.

title: [Phase L] Design controlled collective intelligence
body:
## Goal
Share verified world knowledge and validated experience between controlled RockSoul instances.

## Acceptance
Identity, provenance, trust boundaries, conflict resolution, stale-data handling and revocation are designed before cross-instance learning is enabled.

title: [Phase M] Define empirical ASI research gate and evaluation protocol
body:
## Goal
Define what evidence would be required before any ASI classification is even considered.

## Invariant
Age, level, parameter count, autonomy, multi-agent architecture or product branding are not evidence of ASI.

## Acceptance
Evaluation protocol requires broad, reproducible, adversarially tested capability evidence beyond top human performance across relevant domains.
